visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A performer with a blonde wig and a green sparkly leotard emerges from heavy red velvet curtains on a stage. (2) A close-up shot of a digital screen displays the title 'LOVE AND THE CITY' and '愛情城市' in neon-style graphics under bright stage lights. (3) A drag queen with a voluminous blonde wig and purple bodysuit performs a high-energy dance on a red circular stage in a dimly lit, club-like environment. (4) A male attendee wearing a blue shirt and an orange feather boa reacts with a hand over his mouth in surprise, while another man watches beside him. (5) Actors on stage depict emotional scenes: two men lean in for a near-kiss, a woman in a pink blazer sings into a microphone, and two women in school uniforms hold hands. (6) The man in the orange boa is seen drinking a cocktail and interacting with small colorful cards at a bar counter. (7) A drag queen in a green dress adjusts her pearls in a brightly lit dressing room filled with costumes and mirrors. (8) A group of five young adults poses for a photo in front of a 'Bad Bitch' neon sign, holding a large red heart-shaped prop.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 驚喜製造. (2) [Slogan]: LOVE AND THE CITY 愛情城市. [Variety]: 全新作品. (3) [Subtitle]: 這不是一場普通的劇場體驗. (4) [Variety]: (驚呼連連). [Subtitle]: 這是我進入了別人的感情故事裡. (5) [Subtitle]: 一開始大家都有點陌生. (6) [Subtitle]: 但一杯調酒一段破冰. (7) [Variety]: (好像都是自己人了). [Subtitle]: 我們不是坐在舞台前而是被邀請走進. (8) [Subtitle]: 婚姻激情友情與愛情. (9) [Subtitle]: 愛真的能撐起一段關係嗎? 原諒是軟弱還是成全. (10) [Subtitle]: 那些情感有點像照進自己的人生. (11) [Subtitle]: 如果是我的話我會怎麼選. (12) [Subtitle]: 關係中你最害怕什麼? (13) [Subtitle]: 這是一場劇也是一場深夜的對話. (14) [Slogan]: 愛情城市你準備好進入了嗎?

(4) The narrator's tone shifts to a more dramatic, rhythmic pace when listing themes: 'Marriage, Passion, Friendship'.
